#The mode from its tag binding, checked against the tag itself every 5 seconds for the first 30 after the panel opens on an
	#asset (the tick stops then): now and then, as the panel opens
	#on an asset, every tag binding on it stays blank (the whole panel shows nothing) though the tags have their values.
	#Then re-read them all, show the tag's mode, and say so in the log (868mt2m21)
	#30 seconds after the panel opened on this asset, stop the tick
	if self.custom.checkBlank and (self.custom.statusPathSince is None or system.date.secondsBetween(self.custom.statusPathSince, system.date.now()) >= 30):
		self.custom.checkBlank = False
	mode = value['bound']
	path = value['path']
	if mode or not path: return mode
	#Just opened on this asset: the bindings take a moment to deliver, so only a blank one after that is stale
	since = self.custom.statusPathSince
	if since is not None and system.date.secondsBetween(since, system.date.now()) < 6: return mode
	qv = system.tag.readBlocking([path + '/modeName'])[0]
	if not qv.quality.isGood() or not qv.value: return mode	#Not an OEE asset, or no mode written yet
	system.util.getLogger('kanoa.assetInfo').warn("assetInfo: the tag bindings were blank for %s (modeName %s); re-reading them" % (path, qv.value))
	for binding in [
		'custom.oeeInfo',
		'custom.tags.tooling.alertsMessage',
		'custom.tags.tooling.alertsWorstLevel',
		'custom.tags.tooling.primaryCyclesSincePm',
		'custom.tags.tooling.primaryLifetimeCycles',
		'custom.tags.tooling.primaryPartsPerCycle',
		'custom.tags.tooling.primaryToolingAssetId',
		'custom.tags.tooling.primaryToolingName']:
		self.refreshBinding(binding)
	return qv.value

if value is None: return None
	return system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToDict(system.kanoa.asset.getAssetAttributes({'assetId': value}), 'assetAttrName', 'assetAttrValue')

#The asset now, not the value this run started with: as the view opens the binding runs more than once, one run with
	#no asset yet, and the runs can finish out of order, so the last to finish could leave the panel blank (868mt2m21).
	#self is the view here
	try:
		assetId = self.params.value['assetId'] or value
	except:
		assetId = value
	assets = system.kanoa.asset.getAssets({'assetId': assetId or -1})
	info = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(assets, 0)
	if assetId and not info.get('assetPath'):
		system.util.getLogger('kanoa.assetInfo').warn("assetInfo: no asset for assetId %s (value %s): getAssets returned %s rows (%s), user %s" % (
			assetId, value, assets.rowCount if hasattr(assets, 'rowCount') else '-', type(assets).__name__, self.session.props.auth.user.userName))
	#The asset's OEE tags are in the kanoaMES tag provider, at its asset path
	info['oeePath'] = info['assetPath'].replace('\\', '/') if info.get('assetPath') else None
	return info

#Runs when the asset or its time zone changes, and once a minute so the week's figures move on: it ran on every new
	#assetInfo object, which the parent passes about twice a minute (868mub5yy). The runs while the view opens have no asset
	if not value['assetId']: return []

	endDate = system.date.now()
	dayNum = system.date.getDayOfWeek(endDate)
	startDate = system.date.addDays(endDate, -dayNum+2)
	startDate = system.date.setTime(startDate, 0,0,0)
	tzOffsetMins = system.kanoa.date.getTimeZoneOffsetMins(value['timeZone'], startDate)
	startDate = system.date.addMinutes(startDate, tzOffsetMins)
	
	modeId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('modeId', system.kanoa.asset.getAssetModes({'assetId': value['assetId'] or -1, 'modeName': 'Production'}))
	production = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.event.getAssetProductionEventsSummary({'assetId': value['assetId'] or -1, 'modeId': modeId, 'startDate': startDate, 'endDate': endDate, 'strictDates': True}))
	
	#A family tool's other items (co-products) aren't production events, so the summary leaves them out: add the week's
	#co-product outfeed by item, in the runs' outfeed units, as the Output box shows them
	units = next((row['outfeedUnits'] for row in production if row['outfeedUnits']), '')
	coProducts = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.event.getCounterEventTotals({'assetId': value['assetId'] or -1, 'startDate': startDate, 'endDate': endDate, 'isCoProduct': True, 'counterTypeName': 'outfeed'}))
	for row in coProducts:
		if row['itemName'] and row['value']:
			production.append({'itemName': row['itemName'], 'itemDescription': None, 'outfeedCount': row['value'], 'outfeedUnits': units, 'durationSecs': None, 'isCoProduct': True})
	
	return production

transforms.code:
#shiftStart from its own tag binding: a binding on a child of custom.oeeInfo fires whenever any sibling changes, so on
	#every count, and this queries downtime (868mu89th)
	# The same notifications the Notifications widget (kanoa/core/dbp/widgets/notifications/notifications) lists, counted
	#The asset now, not the value this run started with: as the view opens this runs more than once, one run with no asset yet,
	#and the runs can finish out of order (868mvh89k; the assetInfo binding does the same, 868mt2m21)
	info = value['assetInfo'] or {}
	if not info.get('assetId'):
		try: info = self.custom.assetInfo or {}
		except: pass
	assetId = info.get('assetId')
	locale = self.session.props.locale
	tr = lambda s: system.util.translate(s, locale)
	summary = {'count': 0, 'level': 0, 'text': tr('No notifications')}
	if not assetId: return summary
	parts = []
	level = 0
	# Uncoded downtime since the shift started
	start = value['shiftStart']
	if start is not None and not hasattr(start, 'getTime'): start = system.date.fromMillis(start)
	start = start or system.date.midnight(system.date.now())
	#Only query when what it uses has changed: the asset, the shift start, the checks or the minute (a tag binding also fires
	#when only the quality or timestamp changes)
	ms = lambda d: d.getTime() if hasattr(d, 'getTime') else d
	key = '%s|%s|%s|%s' % (assetId, ms(start), hash(str(value['checks'])), ms(value['now']) // 60000 if value['now'] else None)
	#Reuse a result only with the key it was worked out for, stored once its queries finished. Storing the key before querying
	#let a second run return the card's old value ("No notifications") while the first was still querying (868mvh89k)
	cache = self.custom.summaryCache
	if cache and cache['key'] == key and cache['result']: return cache['result']
	try:
		downtime = system.kanoa.event.getAssetStateEvents({'assetId': assetId, 'durationSecs': 0, 'showChanged': False, 'showDowntimeOnly': True, 'startDate': start, 'endDate': system.date.now()}).getRowCount()
	except:
		downtime = 0
	if downtime:
		parts.append(tr('{n} uncoded downtime event' if downtime == 1 else '{n} uncoded downtime events').replace('{n}', str(downtime)))
		level = max(level, 1)
	# Quality checks coming due, due, overdue, in progress or missed
	checks = {}
	try:
		for row in system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(value['checks']):
			if row['assetId'] != assetId or row['auto']: continue
			if row['activeState'] or row['chkShtStateName'] == 'Missed': checks[row['chkShtStateName']] = checks.get(row['chkShtStateName'], 0) + 1
	except:
		pass
	for state, n in sorted(checks.items()):
		parts.append(tr('{n} quality check {state}' if n == 1 else '{n} quality checks {state}').replace('{n}', str(n)).replace('{state}', tr(state).lower()))
		level = max(level, 2 if state in ('Overdue', 'Missed') else 1)
	# Measures out of control
	measures = 0
	if info.get('tagPath'):
		paths = []
		for typeId in ('Kanoa/measure', '[Kanoa]_types_/Kanoa/measure'):
			for result in system.tag.browse(path=info['tagPath'], filter={'tagType': 'UdtInstance', 'typeId': typeId, 'recursive': True}).results:
				paths.append(str(result['fullPath']) + '/outOfControl')
		if paths: measures = len([qv for qv in system.tag.readBlocking(paths) if qv.value])
	if measures:
		parts.append(tr('{n} measure out of control' if measures == 1 else '{n} measures out of control').replace('{n}', str(measures)))
		level = 2
	# Tooling due for maintenance or over a limit
	tooling = 0
	alerts = system.kanoa.tooling.getAlerts({'assetId': assetId})
	if alerts is not None and not isinstance(alerts, basestring) and alerts.getRowCount():
		n = tooling = alerts.getRowCount()
		parts.append(tr('{n} tooling alert' if n == 1 else '{n} tooling alerts').replace('{n}', str(n)))
		level = max([level] + [2 if (r['level'] or 0) >= 2 else 1 for r in system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(alerts)])
	count = downtime + sum(checks.values()) + measures + tooling
	result = {'count': count, 'level': level, 'text': ', '.join(parts)} if parts else summary
	self.custom.summaryCache = {'key': key, 'result': result}
	return result

#The tab's scope from OEE/info: the current run's values, or the current shift's
	info = value['info']
	if info is None: return None
	return info['shift'] if value['scope'] == 'Current Shift' else info['run']

#The selected tab's (the run's or the shift's) average since its start: its infeed and its target over its running time,
	#per hour when the run's standard rate is per hour, else per minute
	locale = self.session.props.locale
	tr = lambda s: system.util.translate(s, locale)
	hour = value['period'] == 'Hour'
	periods = (value['runtimeSecs'] or 0) / (3600.0 if hour else 60.0)
	if periods <= 0: return ''
	actual = '{:,}'.format(round((value['infeedCount'] or 0) / periods, 1))
	standard = '-' if value['targetCount'] is None else '{:,}'.format(round(value['targetCount'] / periods, 1))
	return tr('{actual} / {standard} {units} per hour' if hour else '{actual} / {standard} {units} per min').replace('{actual}', actual).replace('{standard}', standard).replace('{units}', value['infeedUnits'] or '')
return "#ffffff" if value == "--kcBad" or value == "--kcGood" else "#000000"

#Each item's week: the summary has a row per run (rate, order), so the counts and run times add up (868mu5ca9). Co-product
	#rows (made alongside another item, on a family tool) add units but no time: they're counted apart so the line can say so
	itemValues = {}
	for row in value:
		if row['itemName'] is None or not row['outfeedCount']: continue
		item = itemValues.setdefault(row['itemName'], {'outfeedCount': 0, 'coProductCount': 0, 'outfeedUnits': '', 'itemDescription': '', 'durationSecs': 0})
		item['outfeedCount'] += row['outfeedCount']
		if row.get('isCoProduct'): item['coProductCount'] += row['outfeedCount']
		item['outfeedUnits'] = row['outfeedUnits'] or item['outfeedUnits']
		if row['durationSecs'] is not None: item['durationSecs'] += row['durationSecs']
		if row['itemDescription']: item['itemDescription'] = row['itemDescription']
	return [{'value': {'itemName': k, 'itemDescription': v['itemDescription'], 'outfeedCount': v['outfeedCount'], 'coProductCount': v['coProductCount'],
		'outfeedUnits': v['outfeedUnits'], 'durationSecs': v['durationSecs']}} for k, v in itemValues.items()]
return len(value) > 0
